name: LaFlux Default
author: OrhaByte Software Labs LLP
description: Modern multi-purpose Blade theme for LaFlux CMS with customizable sections driven by categories, tags, banners, and forms.

hero.label: Hero Slider Section
hero.description: Top hero banner displayed at the top of the homepage.

fallback_subtitle.label: Fallback Subtitle
fallback_subtitle.default: Build fast, modern, multilingual websites with modular Laravel 13 packages.

highlights.label: Highlights / Features Section
highlights.description: 3-column showcase cards pulled dynamically from Posts in a chosen Category or Tag.

heading.label: Section Heading
heading.default: Everything You Need to Launch Fast

subtitle.label: Section Subtitle
subtitle.default: A flexible, modular content platform engineered for performance, multilingual publishing, and effortless administration.

latest_posts.label: Latest Articles / Blog Section
latest_posts.description: Blog post cards section driven by your chosen Category, Tag, and Sort Order.

subtitle.label: Section Subtitle
subtitle.default: Insights, product updates, and stories published straight from LaFlux CMS.

contact_cta.label: Contact / Get In Touch Section
contact_cta.description: Bottom call-to-action paired with a configurable CMS Form.

description.label: Description
description.default: Send us a message using our dynamic CMS form. Every submission is validated and stored directly in your LaFlux Admin inbox.

branding.label: Branding & Footer
branding.description: Theme primary accent color and footer bio text.

footer_tagline.label: Footer Tagline
footer_tagline.default: Modern modular Laravel 13 CMS with multilingual pages, posts, menus, sliders, media library, and dynamic forms.

cookie_policy.label: GDPR & Cookie Policy Banner
cookie_policy.description: Bottom slide-up cookie consent bar with Accept & Reject buttons configured per language.

content.label: Cookie & GDPR Notice Content
content.default: We use cookies to enhance your browsing experience, analyze site traffic, and serve personalized content in compliance with GDPR. Click Accept All to consent or Reject to decline non-essential cookies.

default.label: Default Page
default.description: Standard editorial page layout with banner header and content card.

services.label: Services Showcase
services.description: Fancy services layout with styled cards pulled from a chosen Category/Tag plus bottom CTA & Form.

subtitle.label: Hero Subtitle
subtitle.default: Tailored digital solutions engineered for speed, scale, and reliability.

cta_text.label: Bottom CTA Description
cta_text.default: Tell us about your project requirements and our team will prepare a tailored plan.

contact.label: Contact Split Layout
contact.description: Two-column contact page with info cards on the left and a dynamic CMS Form on the right.

subtitle.label: Hero Subtitle
subtitle.default: We would love to hear from you. Reach out anytime.

landing.label: Full-Width Landing Page
landing.description: Marketing landing layout with optional Hero Banner, full-width content, and featured posts strip.
